correctness.rationale: The unique-branch-point Artin--Schreier normal-form proof reduces all cases to 32 distinct isomorphism representatives. Input and output are embedded.

value.rationale: The exact number and multiplicities of Jacobian isogeny types in a whole natural Newton stratum of genus-three moduli is a motivated independent arithmetic invariant. Exhibits 18 types sharing the same 2-rank and Newton slopes, with rational-point extremes 1 and 9, providing a reproducible isogeny-spectrum benchmark distinct from prior isomorphism totals.
